description:
Add CLI help examples for platforms currently missing from `benchbox run --help examples`.

Missing platforms: Firebolt, Presto, Trino, Athena, PostgreSQL, Azure Synapse, Fabric Warehouse

Each platform needs 3-5 practical examples showing:
- Basic connection and authentication
- Platform-specific options (catalog, warehouse, workgroup, etc.)
- Common use cases (with comments explaining what each does)
